title: What Robot Artist Studios Is
definition: Robot Artist Studios: studios where robots create original art.
description:
Robot Artist Studios — Signature Edition: studios where robots create original art. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature studio hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: painter arms rethought, studio logistics rebuilt, style models reimagined for the century ahead. t: The Signature Vision: Robot Artist Studios
title: The Signature Vision: Robot Artist Studios
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Robot Artist Studios.

Signature studio hulls program, charter one: master painter arms at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale studio logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate style models systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

t: 2030 — First studio hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses
title: 2030 — First studio hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses
definition: 2030 milestone on the Robot Artist Studios roadmap.
description:
First studio hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses, farms and human collaboration construction sites.

What must be true first: the painter arms results have to replicate outside the lab, studio logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and style models operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed painter arms demonstrations, studio logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting style models uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Robot Artist Studios
definition: Estimates Robot Artist Studios readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Robot Artist Studios components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a studio hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Robot Artist Studios Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Robot Artist Studios operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Robot Artist Studios installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 1921 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where painter arms monitoring, studio logistics redundancy, or style models maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Robot Artist Studios Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Robot Artist Studios: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Robot Artist Studios — studios where robots create original art.

Phase 1 — Prove (painter arms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (studio logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (style models): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (human collaboration): studio hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and art-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
